newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Fransabank mid-year profits up 36.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Fransabank mid-year profits up 36.5 pct.

text.p: Lebanon's Fransabank reported on Friday a 36.5 percent increase in mid-year net profits to 28.12 billion Lebanese pounds ($18.26 million) over the same period of 1996.
The bank also said its shareholders equity rose by 40.47 percent in the first half of the year to 151.37 billion pounds.
Fransabank said return on assets in the first half of 1997 rose to 1.28 percent from 1.17 percent in the same period of 1996.
Return on shareholders equity at mid-year was 32.52 percent while the bank's solvency ratio stood at 25.30 percent at the end of June.
Fransabank is not listed on the official Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE) but is watched closely by brokers.
